'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Zero Cool
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
